text: Added opt-in BidsNiftiMapLayout. Bundled remains the compatibility default; Individual writes one 3D named NIfTI per coefficient, inferable SE, contrast estimate, and contrast statistic. The JSON sidecar records nifti_map_layout and lists every physical file with its exact map label. Export now rejects unsafe multi-segment stems and preflights sanitized filename collisions before writing. Evidence: sbt fitJVM/test passed 136/136; sbt fitJS/test passed 128/128; scoped git diff --check clean; touched-path trailing-whitespace scan clean. Remaining on this broader child: real HDF5/GDS writers and richer result-family coverage.
